decisions.decision: Represent ambient playback as retained requested state independent of Web Audio eligibility
decisions.why: This permits the browser to honor autoplay immediately while preserving a request for gesture retry after policy rejection
decisions.rejected: Require a gesture before every ambient play attempt

decisions.decision: Keep one reusable AudioContext and reset only failed in-flight activation state
decisions.why: Concurrent gestures coalesce, successful eligibility persists, and failed activation can retry without duplicate context initialization
decisions.rejected: Create a new AudioContext per gesture or permanently cache a failed promise

decisions.decision: Retain SC-002 and SC-007 at their existing strength and close them with behavioral and packaged-output evidence
decisions.why: The implementation supports the stronger contracts, so adding focused tests and a clean-package smoke check is preferable to weakening requirements
decisions.rejected: Narrow success criteria to source-level assertions

decisions.decision: Resolve each manifest entry through DirEntry.Info and require Mode.IsRegular before extension filtering
decisions.why: Info mode is authoritative even when a filesystem reports incomplete type bits
decisions.rejected: Filtering directories alone or trusting DirEntry.Type could admit other non-regular entries

decisions.decision: Play hacking enter feedback only when beginSharedAction returns true
decisions.why: This preserves immediate pre-server feedback for locally dispatchable actions while keeping observer and pending clicks silent
decisions.rejected: Waiting for server acknowledgement would make accepted local feedback lag; unconditional playback contradicts the local dispatch guard
